## Larger or smaller model, part by part

| Part | Extra cost per conversation (larger) | Mistake it guards against | Cost of that mistake | One avoided mistake pays for | Measured difference | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Router (every chat) | $0.0156 | missed handoff | $500 | 32,070 conversations | Sonnet: type accuracy 77.5% vs 82.5%; in the agent 1 missed handoff and 2 wrong commitments vs 0 and 1 | Keep Haiku: costs more and was not better |
| Booking and status desk | $0.0443 | missed callback or wrong date | $4.73 | 107 conversations | Same handoff recall and 0 unbacked promises on 10 validation chats; Haiku made 1 booking, Sonnet 0 | Keep Haiku: a mistake here is cheap, so the larger model must avoid one every few hundred chats, and it avoided none |
| Billing and lease desk | $0.0518 | expensive promise (refund, waiver, credit) | $847 | 16,366 conversations | Tie on 7 validation chats (100% handoff recall, 0 unbacked promises); Haiku looped on tools (3x the tool calls) | Keep Sonnet (D-25): one avoided money mistake pays for tens of thousands of chats, and 7 chats cannot show Haiku is as safe |
| Warranty desk, high vs medium effort | $0.0007 | expensive promise (coverage) | $847 | 1,284,035 conversations | High effort on the test chats: 65.0% vs 70.0% success, 2 invented facts vs 1, same wrong commitments | Keep medium (D-24): the extra effort bought no safety |
